WRITE-ONCE settlement baseline: each player's points the FIRST time their match was published COMPLETED/COMPLETED_FLAGGED. Never edited or overwritten — it is the record of what a contest was settled on, which the draft app diffs the live sheet against. 'provenance' is 'live' when frozen by a normal run, 'seed' when reconstructed from a pre-cricsheet run for a match that completed before this existed.

The owner is re-reconciling all 92 matches from ESPN + Cricbuzz + cricsheet, so those baselines are being re-established from his fresh L1 approvals rather than carried forward. The PRE-RESET FILE IS PRESERVED VERBATIM at registry/settlement_snapshots.pre-recon-20260814.json — it remains the record of what money was actually settled on, and the diff against the new baseline is what tells him which numbers moved.
